sloka: सङ्क्षिप्य हि पुरा लोकान्मायया स्वयमेव हि ।महार्णवे शयानो ऽप्सु मां त्वं पूर्वमजीजनः ।। ७.१०४.४ ॥
transliteration: saṅkṣipya hi purā lokānmāyayā svayameva hi ।mahārṇave śayāno 'psu māṁ tvaṁ pūrvamajījanaḥ ।। 7.104.4 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, formerly, having dissolved the worlds by your own divine power, you lay in the great ocean and begot me in the waters.
